mapper.update: UPDATE know_posts SET status = 'published', publish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND creator_id = #{creatorId} AND status = 'draft'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.tags, p.img_urls AS imgUrls, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.tags_json AS authorTagJson, p.publish_time AS publishTime, p.is_top AS isTop FROM know_posts p JOIN users u ON p.creator_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visible = 'public' ORDER BY p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.tags, p.img_urls AS imgUrls, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.tags_json AS authorTagJson, p.publish_time AS publishTime, p.is_top AS isTop FROM know_posts p JOIN users u ON p.creator_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visible = 'public' AND p.id IN
#{id}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.tags, p.img_urls AS imgUrls, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.tags_json AS authorTagJson, p.publish_time AS publishTime, p.is_top AS isTop FROM know_posts p JOIN users u ON p.creator_id = u.id WHERE p.creator_id = #{creatorId} AND p.status = 'published' ORDER BY p.is_top DESC, p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.creator_id AS creatorId, p.title, p.description, p.tags, p.img_urls AS imgUrls, p.content_url AS contentUrl, p.content_object_key AS contentObjectKey, p.content_etag AS contentEtag, p.content_sha256 AS contentSha256, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.tags_json AS authorTagJson, p.publish_time AS publishTime, p.is_top AS isTop, p.visible, p.type, p.status, p.content_origin AS contentOrigin FROM know_posts p JOIN users u ON p.creator_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.creator_id AS creatorId, p.title, p.description, p.tags, p.img_urls AS imgUrls, p.content_url AS contentUrl, p.content_object_key AS contentObjectKey, p.content_etag AS contentEtag, p.content_sha256 AS contentSha256, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.tags_json AS authorTagJson, p.publish_time AS publishTime, p.is_top AS isTop, p.visible, p.type, p.status, p.content_origin AS contentOrigin FROM know_posts p JOIN users u ON p.creator_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visible = 'public' AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.tags, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publishedPostCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS commentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.creator_id) AS activeCreatorCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS interactingUserCount FROM know_posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'published' AND c.create_time >= #{since} WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visible = 'public' AND p.publish_time >= #{since} AND ( #{topic} = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.tags, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') )

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.creator_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, p.publish_time AS publishTime, COUNT(c.id) AS commentCount FROM know_posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.creator_id LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'published' AND c.create_time >= #{since} WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visible = 'public' AND p.publish_time >= #{since} AND ( #{topic} = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.tags, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') ) GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.description, p.creator_id, u.nickname, p.publish_time ORDER BY commentCount DESC, p.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, COUNT(c.id) AS commentCount FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN know_posts p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.status = 'published' AND c.create_time >= #{since} AND p.status = 'published' AND p.visible = 'public' AND p.publish_time >= #{since} AND ( #{topic} = '' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.tags, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{topic}), '%') ) GROUP BY c.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY commentCount DESC, c.user_id LIMIT #{limit}
